## About
Warren Gear & Axle is an automotive repair shop in Warren, Macomb County Michigan. Our specialty is street and performance axle improvements and repairs, and we work on any make or model.
Bring us more than the rear end, too. We do general automotive repairs, including suspensions, transmissions and exhaust systems.
Customers know John, Bill and the guys by name. One reviewer calls John "professional, honest and fair," and we're rated 4.5 on Google from 73 reviews.

## Services
- Custom Axles: Custom axles for any make or model.
- Gear Repairs and Improvements: Gear work is our specialty, from repairs to improvements.
- Performance Enhancements: Reworking gears for better performance.
- Suspensions: General suspension repairs.
- Transmissions: Transmission repairs alongside our axle and gear work.
- Exhaust systems: Exhaust system repairs.

## FAQ
Q: How do I find the shop?
A: We're a bit tricky to find. Once you're in front of the building, head down the driveway on the right to our building at the back. That's the shop entrance.

Q: Do you work on my make of car?
A: Yes. Our custom axle work covers any make or model.

Q: How soon will I get my vehicle back?
A: One reviewer says they always get their vehicle back when John promises, and it's usually within a few days.
